model_note: the 216.1 h model fine-tuned 40k iterations (lr 1e-4) with two pause tokens on 119,107 clips whose measured pauses are marked in the labels (tools/pause_labels.py); verse labels by the fine-tuned G2P model (g2p/ in the voice dir) and reviewed per-line readings
prompt_phonemes: the f5a prompt's label with its measured pauses (models/ganj-zip-d4h/prompt_phonemes.txt)
prompt_source: corpus_q/clips/18347/15.wav (امیرحسین عظیمی, held out of training)
reading_list: tools/reading_list.py (G2P: verse through the voice's g2p/ model, prose through the base model; per-line readings; reading-time pauses: long at hemistich breaks and after . ! ؟, short after ، ؛ :)
deess: after the pick: in hiss frames 4.5 kHz up turned down by 6 dB for س-like frames (to 9.5 kHz), 60 % of that for ش-like ones (to 7 kHz); attenuation only (packages/ganj-voice/ganj_voice/deess.py)
glue_vav: a standalone «و» after a consonant-final word written onto it in the model input (packages/ganj-voice/ganj_voice/glue.py)
lead_pause: the long pause token before each line in the model input (packages/ganj-voice/ganj_voice/glue.py): the first word is no longer lost after the prompt
draw_choice: tools/pick_draws.py: fewest missing words (CTC), then fewest wrong ezafes (classifier ezafe.joblib in the voice dir) plus short vowels said wrong (vowels.json in the voice dir, fitted on this voice's renders, packages/ganj-eval/ganj_eval/vowelcheck.py), then best CTC fit
identity_note: 50 lines, one draw each, with the 6 dB hiss filter
note: paths relative to GANJ_DATA; recipes/zipvoice/synth_voice.sh runs this recipe
